speaker: Last Star
text: Before the dark, daylight travelled from hand to hand. From beacon to beacon.
direction: Young luminous woman; intimate mythic remembrance spoken to one newly awakened person. Begin almost in a hush, let daylight glow, pause after hand to hand, and land beacon to beacon with tender loss. Spacious, expressive, and never brisk.

speaker: Last Star
text: The Sun-Eater could not destroy that light. So it taught the horizon itself to close.
direction: Young luminous woman; warmth hardening into remembered dread. Give the first sentence grave finality, take a full reflective beat, then reveal the closing horizon with controlled fear. Spacious and cinematic; do not rush.

speaker: Last Star
text: It cut dawn into ten memories and buried each beneath a Sovereign crown.
direction: Young luminous woman; precise mythic exposition with quiet urgency.

speaker: Bearer
text: And me? What did it bury inside me?
direction: Young adult male warrior; low, controlled, newly awake and wary.

speaker: Last Star
text: A vessel made to carry the final spark into its mouth. You woke before it could name you.
direction: Young luminous woman; compassionate, withholding one last fear.

speaker: Bearer
text: So each crown returns a memory.
direction: Young adult male warrior; analytical resolve forming.

speaker: Last Star
text: Each memory lengthens the Trace. At the tenth, the path reaches the Crown of Dawn.
direction: Young luminous woman; clear mission briefing wrapped in wonder.

speaker: Bearer
text: Then we break ten crowns.
direction: Young adult male warrior; concise, fearless vow.

speaker: Last Star
text: Walk, Bearer. I will burn in every step.
direction: Young luminous woman; warm resolve, a promise rather than a command.

speaker: Last Star
text: The first fire remembers where the roads once led.
direction: Young luminous woman; awed by a recovered memory.

speaker: Bearer
text: I expected power. This is only a road.
direction: Young adult male warrior; puzzled, not dismissive.

speaker: Last Star
text: Daylight was never carried by the sky alone. People carried it to one another.
direction: Young luminous woman; tender revelation.

speaker: Bearer
text: Then direction is power. Where does it point?
direction: Young adult male warrior; understanding and purposeful.

speaker: Last Star
text: Into Glassreed Mire. Then let it lead us.
direction: Young luminous woman; hopeful forward momentum.

speaker: Last Star
text: Six voices. None of them belonged to the monster.
direction: Young luminous woman; haunted and compassionate.

speaker: Bearer
text: It kept them alive inside its song.
direction: Young adult male warrior; disturbed realization.

speaker: Last Star
text: Sovereigns preserve fragments of what they consume. Memory makes better bait than ash.
direction: Young luminous woman; bitter knowledge, restrained anger.

speaker: Bearer
text: Can they hear us?
direction: Young adult male warrior; unexpectedly gentle.

speaker: Last Star
text: Only as warmth. But warmth is enough to remember a name.
direction: Young luminous woman; comforting but sad.

speaker: Bearer
text: We carry the voices. Leave the monster here.
direction: Young adult male warrior; solemn decision.

speaker: Last Star
text: They laughed here, even while the sky was failing.
direction: Young luminous woman; surprised warmth through grief.

speaker: Bearer
text: Why would the crown keep this?
direction: Young adult male warrior; curious and wary.

speaker: Last Star
text: Because terror is easier when people forget what joy sounded like.
direction: Young luminous woman; quietly defiant.

speaker: Bearer
text: We are not assembling a weapon, are we?
direction: Young adult male warrior; dawning moral clarity.

speaker: Last Star
text: No. We are restoring the reasons anyone would use one.
direction: Young luminous woman; honest and trusting.

speaker: Bearer
text: Good. Let the night hear them.
direction: Young adult male warrior; a faint smile beneath resolve.

speaker: Sun-Eater
text: Every reflection ends inside me.
direction: Ancient masculine void; composed, intimate menace.

speaker: Last Star
text: Do not look. Those are paths it already owns.
direction: Young luminous woman; sharp fear, protecting the Bearer.

speaker: Bearer
text: I see myself kneeling in every mirror.
direction: Young adult male warrior; shaken but observant.

speaker: Sun-Eater
text: Not prophecy. Memory. You have delivered her before.
direction: Ancient masculine void; amused certainty.

speaker: Last Star
text: Bearer, step away.
direction: Young luminous woman; frightened command.

speaker: Bearer
text: There is one reflection still standing.
direction: Young adult male warrior; steadiness returning.

speaker: Bearer
text: Mine. The one it cannot remember yet.
direction: Young adult male warrior; calm defiance.

speaker: Last Star
text: The sea buried the final road.
direction: Young luminous woman; grief giving way to wonder.

speaker: Bearer
text: Buried is not gone. Look beneath the black water.
direction: Young adult male warrior; grounded reassurance.

speaker: Last Star
text: The causeway is answering the first beacon.
direction: Young luminous woman; startled discovery.

speaker: Bearer
text: Not a road, then. A circuit.
direction: Young adult male warrior; analytical realization.

speaker: Last Star
text: All five memories are aligning toward one place: the Crown of Dawn.
direction: Young luminous woman; reluctant revelation.

speaker: Bearer
text: Then the trap has a destination. So do we.
direction: Young adult male warrior; unafraid resolve.

speaker: Last Star
text: The Engine guarded a door no map remembers.
direction: Young luminous woman; reverent unease.

speaker: Bearer
text: The thunder remembered.
direction: Young adult male warrior; quiet satisfaction.

speaker: Last Star
text: That current has been waiting since the last dawn.
direction: Young luminous woman; awed by ancient persistence.

speaker: Bearer
text: What waits behind the door?
direction: Young adult male warrior; cautious focus.

speaker: Last Star
text: The Hourglass Vault. It recorded every attempt to bring morning back.
direction: Young luminous woman; foreboding exposition.

speaker: Bearer
text: Then it recorded why they failed. Open it.
direction: Young adult male warrior; decisive.

speaker: Sun-Eater
text: I have watched you fail in every hour.
direction: Ancient masculine void; patient superiority.

speaker: Bearer
text: You only watched.
direction: Young adult male warrior; dry contempt.

speaker: Last Star
text: These are earlier Bearers. Every one followed the same route.
direction: Young luminous woman; horrified recognition.

speaker: Bearer
text: And every route delivered you to the Crown.
direction: Young adult male warrior; connecting the trap.

speaker: Sun-Eater
text: Obedience is merely fate with better manners.
direction: Ancient masculine void; amused aphorism.

speaker: Bearer
text: Then we stop obeying the map.
direction: Young adult male warrior; firm strategic pivot.

speaker: Last Star
text: The Foundry still burns beneath us. It may know what you were made to do.
direction: Young luminous woman; worried honesty.

speaker: Bearer
text: What I was made for is not what I will choose.
direction: Young adult male warrior; personal conviction.

speaker: Last Star
text: They made you to carry me.
direction: Young luminous woman; guilt finally spoken.

speaker: Bearer
text: I know that part. Say the rest.
direction: Young adult male warrior; hurt, demanding honesty.

speaker: Last Star
text: Your heart is a lock. At the Crown, it was meant to open and deliver me.
direction: Young luminous woman; ashamed confession.

speaker: Bearer
text: You suspected this from the first beacon.
direction: Young adult male warrior; restrained betrayal.

speaker: Last Star
text: I feared the truth would turn you away before you had a choice.
direction: Young luminous woman; vulnerable apology.

speaker: Bearer
text: Silence was also a choice. Yours.
direction: Young adult male warrior; wounded but controlled.

speaker: Last Star
text: Then choose now. Leave me, and the Crown never opens.
direction: Young luminous woman; accepting loss, no manipulation.

speaker: Bearer
text: They do not choose what I become. We reach the Crown, then reverse the lock.
direction: Young adult male warrior; reconciled, inventive resolve.

speaker: Cartographer echo
text: The map was bait.
direction: Ancient gender-ambiguous machine oracle; damaged whisper.

speaker: Bearer
text: Show me the whole Trace.
direction: Young adult male warrior; focused command.

speaker: Cartographer echo
text: Ten roads. One mouth. Every recovered light flows inward.
direction: Ancient machine oracle; fragmented but intelligible warning.

speaker: Sun-Eater
text: Complete the circuit. Bring me the star.
direction: Ancient masculine void; invitation disguised as command.

speaker: Last Star
text: It used our wake. Every victory tightened the trap.
direction: Young luminous woman; alarm and self-blame.

speaker: Bearer
text: A Trace can be closed from either side.
direction: Young adult male warrior; calm breakthrough.

speaker: Cartographer echo
text: Closure reverses flow. Vessel becomes gate.
direction: Ancient machine oracle; final lucid instruction.

speaker: Last Star
text: If we close it inside the Crown, my light will travel outward.
direction: Young luminous woman; fearful hope.

speaker: Bearer
text: It taught us where to close the line. Now we teach it what dawn means.
direction: Young adult male warrior; climactic resolve.

speaker: Last Star
text: The tenth memory is not a weapon. It is a promise.
direction: Young luminous woman; astonished, on the edge of tears.

speaker: Bearer
text: What did the first people promise?
direction: Young adult male warrior; gentle question before battle.

speaker: Last Star
text: That morning would belong to no star, king, or chosen vessel. It would be shared.
direction: Young luminous woman; revelatory warmth.

speaker: Bearer
text: Then I will not choose your sacrifice for you.
direction: Young adult male warrior; compassionate boundary.

speaker: Last Star
text: Then I choose to open, before its remnant can close around us.
direction: Young luminous woman; a free, certain choice made in the quiet after victory, followed by sudden awareness that something still clings to the Crown.

speaker: Sun-Eater
text: You broke my body. The hunger is not flesh.
direction: Dying remnant of an ancient masculine void; its body is destroyed and its voice is diffused through the Crown. Wounded certainty, never a normal living presence.

speaker: Last Star
text: That is only its echo, clinging to the Crown.
direction: Young luminous woman; instantly recognizing a dangerous afterimage rather than a living enemy, controlled and clear.

speaker: Sun-Eater
text: Echo or god, every road still ends in me.
direction: Disintegrating Crown-bound echo of an ancient masculine void; defiance thinning at the edges as its last certainty fractures.

speaker: Last Star
text: Only while the Trace points inward.
direction: Young luminous woman; the final strategic realization arriving through fear, concise and urgent.

speaker: Bearer
text: Then we turn it.
direction: Young adult male warrior; absolute calm, recognizing the solution without hesitation.

speaker: Bearer
text: Ten memories. One closed line. Outward, now.
direction: Young adult male warrior; forceful release cue, building cleanly toward outward and striking now.

speaker: Sun-Eater
text: No. There is no mouth left to hold the dawn.
direction: Final collapsing remnant of an ancient masculine void; horrified recognition that its body and dominion are already gone, dissolving into silence.

speaker: Last Star
text: I was never the last light. I was the first.
direction: Young luminous woman; radiant self-realization.

speaker: Bearer
text: Then let morning belong to everyone.
direction: Young adult male warrior; quiet victorious conclusion.
